name: Dual Shield Vanguard (Combat)
body:
Shields are helpful in keeping you alive, why not two?

Prerequisite(s): Weapons of the guardian.

Benefit(s): You may use two shields when dual-wielding for weapons of the guardian. This feat does not allow the stacking of shield bonuses.

Normal: Weapons of the guardian does not allow the use of two shields simultaneously.
